title: Fx0 Sxmo idle and auto-suspend: fixtures removed and Linux 6.18.64-r7 with wakelocks
owner_approval: The owner approved enabling idle and suspend and installing r7 in this session.

blockers_found.symptom: power button never locked and idle never left unlock
sxmo_autosuspend never started, so the phone never suspended by itself

power_key.evtest: one KEY_POWER press and release per physical press

r7.config: CONFIG_PM_WAKELOCKS=y, LIMIT=100, GC=y; otherwise identical to r6

RAM_check.observed: idle about 2 min -> lock -> screenoff -> sxmo_suspend s2idle; power button woke it

exact_trial.note: the workload releases userspace wakelocks before its RTC request; Sxmo holds sxmo_not_suspendable while unlocked, which blocks reading wakeup_count

installed_state.owner_checks: display and power button OK; touch works after the second press (lock stage)

standby_logger: /var/lib/fx0-standby/log.sh every 5 min via transient timer fx0-standby-log -> /var/log/fx0-standby/log.jsonl (until reboot)
limits: overnight unplugged standby not yet observed
SSH sessions block Sxmo suspend by design
